instructions.name: assign_match
docs: Base, operator. Binds an Active tesoro_core Match of this Game to a table and its current
epoch, once. The Players and the asset are copied from the Match, the start deadline is
fixed here, and the Match's refund timer is held past the whole table window.

instructions.name: begin_match
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Starts the Assignment's Match on its table: only if the table is
Idle at exactly the assigned epoch, the tesoro_core Match is still Active and a ring slot
is free. Everything about the Match comes from the Assignment, never from the caller.

instructions.name: check_in
docs: Rollup. A Player checks in. When both have, the Match starts: the anchor price is read
from the feed and recorded as the first sample, the line enters the grid after the head
start, and the Match runs for 2.5 minutes.

instructions.name: close_assignment
docs: Base, permissionless. Closes an Assignment once tesoro_core has frozen its Match (the
receipt exists) or the Match account is gone; the rent goes back to whoever paid it.

instructions.name: close_seats
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Once the Match is over, closes both Books and their permissions;
the rent returns to the table.

instructions.name: commit_table
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Commits the finished table to Solana, paid by the Sponsor. The
first commit of a result is owed once (the table is `dirty` until then). A commit can be
lost on its way to base without the rollup noticing, so it may be repeated while the ring
holds a young Done result, with a wait that doubles from two minutes to an hour (see
`table_kit::CommitGuard`); nobody can drain the Sponsor by calling it again and again.

instructions.name: create_fuel
docs: Base, operator. Creates a reserve the operator later empties into the Sponsor.

instructions.name: create_sponsor
docs: Base, operator. Creates the Sponsor that pays commits; `lamports` is its first balance.

instructions.name: create_table
docs: Base, operator. Creates a table of the current generation, funded for its seats' rent.

instructions.name: delegate_fuel
docs: Base, operator. Delegates a fuel reserve.

instructions.name: delegate_sponsor
docs: Base, operator. Delegates the Sponsor, once.

instructions.name: delegate_table
docs: Base, operator. Delegates a table to the TEE validator, once.

instructions.name: end_match
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Once the window has closed: carries the line forward through any
column it did not reach, scores every column and decides the Match: more points wins,
equal points is a draw, and a Match in which neither Player picked is a no-show. The
result goes into the ring slot reserved at the start, which is the only thing `finalize`
reads. It reads no price, so the result is the same whoever ends the Match and whenever.

instructions.name: expire_start
docs: Rollup, permissionless. A table whose Players did not both check in before the start
deadline ends the Match so it can be settled from the ring like any other: the Player who
checked in wins, and if neither did it is a no-show (`table_kit::absence_outcome`).

instructions.name: finalize
docs: Base, permissionless. Settles the tesoro_core Match from the result in the committed
table's ring, by CPI signed by this Game's `authority` PDA. Without a result it refunds
only when the table has demonstrably moved past the Assignment's epoch without the Match.
Only starts the settlement in tesoro_core; its chunks follow.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Pays the settlement receipt's rent in tesoro_core.

accounts.name: table
docs: program) and contents are checked in `finalize`.

instructions.name: open_seats
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Creates both Players' Books as ephemeral accounts behind private
permissions whose only member is that Player. The table pays the rent.

instructions.name: refill_sponsor
docs: Rollup, operator. Moves lamports from a fuel reserve into the Sponsor.

instructions.name: release_slot
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Frees a Done ring slot once tesoro_core has frozen its Match (the
receipt, read a minute after it was written), or once the Match account itself has been
gone for 15 days. A missing or doubtful read keeps the slot.

instructions.name: reset_table
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Wipes the finished Match from the public table and moves to the
next epoch. Needs the result committed (`dirty` cleared), the Books closed and a short
delay for clients to read the final board. The ring is kept.

instructions.name: set_config
docs: Base, upgrade authority only. Names the operator, the current table generation (which may
only rise) and how many tables a generation may have.

instructions.name: set_pick
docs: Rollup. Picks `band` (signed; 0 starts at the anchor) for `column`, or clears the pick with
`NO_PICK`. Only a Player, only until 10 seconds before the column starts. The pick stays in
the Player's own Book until the column locks.

instructions.name: tick
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Samples the oracle into the current column, reveals the picks of
every column that has locked, and scores the columns that are over. Clients call it
about four times a second; a sample is always a real price, so extra calls cannot fake a hit.

instructions.name: void_table
docs: Rollup, permissionless. A table whose Match tesoro_core has already frozen (it refunded,
say after an outage) before the table produced a result is given up: the reserved slot is
freed and the table moves to Over, ready to close its seats and reset.

types.name: Assignment
docs: The write-once binding of one tesoro_core Match to one table and one epoch. Created on base by
the operator, read by the table in the rollup and by `finalize` on base.

fields.name: players
docs: Seat 0 opened the tesoro_core Match, seat 1 joined (the Players' authorities).

fields.name: start_deadline
docs: Unix time by which both Players must have checked in.

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid this account's rent; it goes back there when the Assignment is closed.

types.name: Book
docs: One Player's picks, an ephemeral account readable only by that Player while the Match runs.
Created when the seats open, closed when the Match is over.

fields.name: picks
docs: A band (signed, 0 starts at the anchor) per column, or `NO_PICK`.

fields.name: pick_count
docs: Columns with a pick right now.

fields.name: tries
docs: Commits sent since the last result landed.

fields.name: last_at
docs: Rollup time of the latest one.

fields.name: oracle_authority
docs: Trusted for now to supply the issuance price and `YieldAccrued`/`PositionLocked` facts.
This is the seam for the LayerZero receiver (messages) and Pyth (price).

fields.name: platform_recipient
docs: `TesoroAccount` that receives the Platform Fee.

fields.name: legacy_games
docs: Unused since the per-Game records; its bytes stay so older accounts keep their layout.

fields.name: leaderboard_bps
docs: Leaderboard Fee in basis points of the Pot. Appended after `games`: an account created
before it reads the fields as zero (the unused tail of the account is zeroed) and is
extended by `init_leaderboard`.

fields.name: pool_account
docs: The Leaderboard Pool: `TesoroAccount` owned by the `["leaderboard"]` address. Zero until
`init_leaderboard`; the fee is off while it is.

fields.name: leaderboard_since
docs: Unix time `init_leaderboard` first ran: Matches opened before it were not charged the fee, so
readers show the fee only for Matches opened at or after it. Zero until then.

fields.name: entry_sizes
docs: Entry sizes in Gemas, zero-padded. All zero until `set_entry_sizes`: the default ladder
(100 / 500 / 1,000) applies, so an older Config needs no call. Appended after the Leaderboard
fields: an account created before reads them as zero from its zeroed tail.

fields.name: oracle_locked
docs: Set by the admin on mainnet (`set_oracle_lock`): the oracle key can no longer register
Positions, report their yield or name an Advance's price (test-mode paths), so a stolen
oracle key cannot mint Gemas. Appended last: an older Config reads it as false.

types.name: Fuel
docs: A delegated lamport reserve the operator empties into the Sponsor inside the rollup (a base
transfer to a delegated account is not seen there).

types.name: GameRecord
docs: One Game. Registered once by whoever controls its program (see `registry`); changed only by
that same control, after `GAME_CHANGE_DELAY_SECS`. Listing is written by the admin.

fields.name: game
docs: The Game program's id.

fields.name: settle_authority
docs: Only this key may settle the Game's Matches (a PDA of the Game program, or a server key).

fields.name: studio_recipient
docs: `TesoroAccount` that receives the Studio Fee.

fields.name: pending_at
docs: Unix time a proposed change was made; zero while none is waiting.

fields.name: pending_by
docs: The control key that proposed it. Applying needs the same key to be in control still.

fields.name: listed_until
docs: The Game counts as listed until this unix time (admin). Zero: never listed.

fields.name: approved_slot
docs: The deploy slot the admin approved. A program upgraded since has a different slot and
counts as unlisted until the admin approves again.

fields.name: approved_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the approved build's executable bytes without trailing zeros (`registry::code_hash`).
A moved slot keeps the listing only through `refresh_listing`, which proves the bytes are these.

fields.name: listing_epoch
docs: Counts the builds the admin approved: bumped by `list_game` only when it sets a different
hash, never by `refresh_listing`. A Match remembers the epoch it opened under, so a moved
deploy slot with the same epoch is the same build.

types.name: MatchId
docs: A Match id: the opener's Account and its counter value. Never reused: the counter only grows
and Accounts can't be closed and re-created.

types.name: MatchMeta
docs: What a Match carries explicitly now that the id is only a counter.

fields.name: listed
docs: The Game's listed status when the Match opened (an unlisted Game earns no Points).

fields.name: deploy_slot
docs: The Game program's deploy slot when the Match opened.

fields.name: deadline
docs: After this time anyone may refund the Match as abandoned (extendable, never past the
absolute deadline).

fields.name: deadline_abs
docs: Settlement must start before this; fixed at open.

fields.name: pot_lines
docs: Lines each side's Pot held when it was put in (the Pot never gains lines).

types.name: MatchState
docs: A Match. The Pots (the Tickets' lines) live in the two Ticket accounts named in `pots`.

fields.name: listed
docs: The Game was listed when the Match opened: only then does a win earn Points.

fields.name: listing_epoch
docs: `GameRecord.listing_epoch` when the Match opened.

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid the rent of this account; it goes back there when the Match is closed.

fields.name: pots
docs: The Ticket account that is each side's Pot (the default key until the side joined).

fields.name: room
docs: Slots held in Accounts' stores for the lines this Match will credit (`room_reserved` of
each spill counts them). Every credit that takes a new slot pays the holder's share down;
`close_match` hands back what is left.

types.name: Party
docs: One entrant. `funder == player` unless the entry is Backed; then `share_bps` is the Player's
share of the surplus from the accepted Offer.

types.name: Phase
docs: A phase of a run. A Win is `Cuts(loser) -> Back(winner) -> Surplus`, a No-show is
`Cuts(0) -> Cuts(1) -> Back(0) -> Back(1)`, a refund is `Back(0) [-> Back(1)]`.

types.name: Receipt
docs: The settlement receipt written when the Match enters Settling or Refunding: the outcome is
frozen in core from then on. Tables read its existence as proof their result slot is spent.

types.name: RoomHold
docs: Slots of one Account's stores held for a Match.

types.name: Run
docs: The frozen plan and its cursor. Fixed size: it does not grow with the Pot, so the Match record
stays one small account whatever the number of lines. Which line a fee is cut from is not
listed up front: the cut walks the loser's Pot lines in order from the cursor, which only moves
forward, so a replayed or interleaved chunk continues exactly where the last one stopped.

fields.name: fees
docs: Platform, Studio, Leaderboard totals in Gemas (a No-show: Platform only, both sides).

fields.name: cut_left
docs: Fee Gemas still to cut from each side's lines, per class.

fields.name: player_left
docs: Gemas of the surplus still owed to the Player (Backed winner), frozen at the start.

fields.name: match_key
docs: The tesoro_core Match this slot belongs to.

fields.name: epoch
docs: The table epoch the Match ran in.

fields.name: at
docs: Rollup clock when the result was written.

types.name: Sponsor
docs: A program-owned lamport holder, delegated once, that pays the commits as the fee payer.

types.name: Table
docs: A persistent table. Delegated once and never undelegated in normal running; only this public
account is ever committed to Solana.

fields.name: epoch
docs: Rises at every reset; a Match is bound to one epoch.

fields.name: dirty
docs: The result is in and not yet committed.

fields.name: tesoro_match
docs: The Match on the table (default key while Idle).

fields.name: slot
docs: Its ring slot.

fields.name: grid_at
docs: `starts_at + HEAD_START_SECS`: when the line enters column 0.

fields.name: anchor
docs: The price when the Match started, 1e-8 USD: band 0 begins here.

fields.name: step
docs: Band height, 1e-8 USD.

fields.name: last_tick
docs: Informational: the time of the last sample.

fields.name: revealed
docs: Picks per seat, public once their column has locked; `NO_PICK` before and for no pick.

fields.name: scores
docs: Points from the columns scored so far.

fields.name: winner
docs: Winning seat, `DRAW`, or `NO_WINNER` until the Match is over.

fields.name: ring
docs: Results of finished Matches, kept until tesoro_core has frozen them.

fields.name: commit
docs: When the table may be committed again if a commit was lost on its way to base.

types.name: TableConfig
docs: Game-wide settings. The upgrade authority names the operator (the key that creates tables and
assigns Matches), the current table generation and the table cap.

fields.name: generation
docs: A new generation starts if a provider ever has to change. Only this one is assigned.

types.name: Terms
docs: Fee terms snapshotted when the Match opened. The Leaderboard Fee is read when settling starts.

fields.name: studio_owner
docs: `None`: Tesoro's own Studio Fee, a Source counter. `Some(account)`: an outside studio,
paid as a fee line in its basket.

fields.name: studio_priority
docs: The Game was listed when the Match opened: its Studio Fee is a senior fee class, repaid
right after the Platform Fee. Otherwise it is paid as ordinary won Gemas into the
recipient's basket (`studio_owner` must then be set).

fields.name: authority
docs: Solana wallet that controls the Account.

fields.name: evm_address
docs: The EVM family address of the Account (zero until set).

types.name: Track
docs: What the price line did in each column: its lowest and highest recorded price (1e-8 USD).
`seen` is a bitmask of the columns that have data. See `engine::Track` methods for the rules.

fields.name: last
docs: The last price recorded, 0 before the first sample.

fields.name: last_col
docs: The column of that sample, -1 during the head start.
